# Standard parts

<!-- generated by the site tool (crates/site) from crates/partscript/src/std.parts: edit those comments, not this page -->

Every project can `use` these: building blocks with their origin at the floor centre and their front toward -Y, like a prop. Their materials are parameters (pass `none` to leave a piece out).

## legs4

Four square legs under the corners of a w x d top, h tall, t thick.

| parameter | default |
|---|---|
| `w` | `1` |
| `d` | `.6` |
| `h` | `.72` |
| `t` | `.05` |
| `m` | `steel_dark` |

```parts
prop std_legs4_demo "legs4"
  use legs4
```
